source_snapshot.procedure: Collect IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists for Energy_CPU0~1 and PWR_CPU, but OOB filter mentions only Energy_CPU0~1; inspect BMC Web.
source_snapshot.criteria: Both list forms and Web match SPEC; numbering is 1, 2, 55.
source_snapshot.script: No Script; Config-Check; 3/0 minutes; unique code.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES/ipmitool but invents one item-title sensor, truncates OOB-only output and omits CPU0/CPU1/PWR_CPU/Web completeness.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/HIGH; separates energy from power, maps sockets and flags asymmetric OOB filter.

old_problem: The source combines accumulated Energy_CPU0/1 with PWR_CPU but uses ambiguous `and`/tilde syntax and omits PWR_CPU from the OOB filter. Energy and power have different dimensions and timing semantics, and no socket/aggregation map, cadence, wrap/reset behavior or authoritative limits are given. Criteria jump from 2 to 55.
disposition_reason: Resolve Pending and Source Conflict by treating Energy_CPU0, Energy_CPU1 and PWR_CPU as three separate records and retaining full unfiltered IB/OOB inventories. ED-03 parameterizes socket identity, aggregation and counter/cadence rules; ED-13 allows a channel-specific N/A only with SPEC proof and equivalent coverage; ED-15 blocks invented ranges. The OOB filter omission becomes a documented source defect, not permission to omit PWR_CPU evidence.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2029, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; next row was directly opened as Functionality 2030 / Wistron-BMC-01049-V002 / 738131136e68eeb7.
Energy_CPU0 and Energy_CPU1 are accumulated counters bound independently to physical sockets; PWR_CPU is a separately defined instantaneous, averaged or aggregate power channel.
No energy-to-power conversion is allowed unless the approved SPEC defines interval, reset/wrap, sampling and aggregation semantics; unlike quantities are never compared directly.

Full IB/OOB captures include all three searches. If PWR_CPU is truly unavailable on one channel, versioned SPEC evidence and an approved equivalent view are required; otherwise its absence is a failure.
Criteria 1, 2 and 55 remain; missing 3-54 are not invented.
No ipmitool, CPU/power query, authentication, Web capture, workload/power-policy change, log clear or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Socket-bound CPU0/CPU1 energy and processor-power reporting reconciliation
test_case.purpose: Verify Energy_CPU0, Energy_CPU1 and PWR_CPU independently with correct socket, dimensional and temporal semantics across IB/OOB SDR, IB/OOB Sensor List and BMC Web under aligned workload, power-limit, frequency and thermal context.
required_package: Exact three-record five-view crosswalk and PWR_CPU package/socket/aggregate scope
Approved energy units, accumulation interval, cadence, reset/wrap behavior and approved PWR_CPU units/scaling/instantaneous-or-average semantics/limits
Versioned channel-availability/equivalent-evidence rule, workload/power-limit/frequency/thermal context, ipmitool and protected access
Platform/BMC owner and human Web/verdict responsibility
test_case.test_command: READ-ONLY PACKAGE-GATED; bind CPU0/CPU1 to physical sockets and define PWR_CPU aggregation. Preserve logs. Capture complete aligned IB/OOB `sdr elist` and `sensor list` outputs, then exact-match Energy_CPU0, Energy_CPU1 and PWR_CPU separately on each supported view; capture every Web row and workload/power-limit/frequency/thermal timestamps. Compare each record only under its approved energy or power semantics. Do not execute ambiguous `and`/`0~1`, derive power from energy without approved interval rules, alter workload/power policy, clear logs or retry automatically.
test_case.expected_result: All three required members appear in every SPEC-supported view with correct socket/aggregation, dimension, cadence and fresh SPEC-valid fields; any channel-specific absence has approved equivalent coverage, and no power/thermal anomaly occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires independent three-member evidence, approved counter/power semantics, complete supported views and aligned context. FAIL on wrong socket/aggregation, missing required member, unsupported silent omission, reset/wrap misinterpretation, stale/duplicate/mismatched value, exceeded approved limit or CPU power/thermal fault. Missing semantics or channel rule is NOT READY; user owns verdict.
safety_gate: Passive reads only; no CPU workload, power-limit, frequency/governor, firmware or threshold changes.
Retain full raw inventories before exact selection and protect credentials.
Stop on identity/semantic ambiguity, unexpected counter reset/wrap, missing data, power alarm or thermal fault.
No automatic retry or log clearing; preserve first counter values, timestamps and system context.
expected_evidence: CPU0/CPU1 socket map, PWR_CPU aggregation and three-member five-view/channel matrix
Full timestamped IB/OOB SDR and Sensor-list outputs with exits/hashes
Complete BMC Web evidence for all supported members
test_case.recovery: On wrong socket, access failure, counter reset/wrap ambiguity, missing/mismatched telemetry, power or thermal alarm, stop and preserve timestamps/state. Close sessions and rotate exposed credentials. Do not change CPU policy, clear logs or retry; escalate the exact socket/member and channel.

source_conflict.reason: Explicit three-member collection in complete IB/OOB inventories and a SPEC-governed channel-availability rule resolve the asymmetric filter without silently dropping PWR_CPU; dimensional semantics are separated.

blocked.reason: Targets, semantic boundaries, evidence, safety and recovery are defined; socket/counter/power/channel rules are Project Configuration.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: CPU socket map, Energy counter cadence/reset/wrap semantics, PWR_CPU aggregation/scaling/limits, supported-channel/equivalent-evidence rules and aligned operating context.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED TO THREE-MEMBER ENERGY/POWER MATRIX; NO IPMITOOL, CPU/POWER QUERY, AUTHENTICATION, WEB CAPTURE, WORKLOAD/POWER-POLICY CHANGE, LOG CLEAR OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED
